facts.text: The hotel's design blends modern, linear architecture with organic materials and traditional Thai artisanship.
facts.excerpt: Blending modern, linear architecture with organic materials and traditional Thai artisanship

facts.text: The hotel sits on Langsuan Road near Lumphini Park.
facts.excerpt: our boutique hotel rests on the leafy landscape of Langsuan Road near Lumphini Park

facts.text: The hotel has one outdoor pool, on the third floor, overlooking the Langsuan garden oasis.
facts.excerpt: Located on the third floor, overlooking the lush Langsuan oasis

facts.text: The hotel has a spa called amaranth spa.
Pets are welcome at no extra charge, whatever their size, weight or breed.
facts.excerpt: No matter their size, weight, or breed, they will be pampered and treated as little guests. The best part: all at no extra charge.

facts.text: Through the Kimpton Pets programme the hotel offers pet menus, special amenities and pet sitter services.
facts.excerpt: we provide everything from pet menus to special amenities, and even pet sitter services

facts.text: A rooftop terrace with city views is one of the hotel's drinking spots.
facts.excerpt: end the night on our rooftop terrace with stunning city views

facts.text: The hotel has a neighbourhood-inspired eatery serving farm-to-plate food, a lobby lounge for morning coffee, and a cocktail bar.
facts.excerpt: Start with morning coffee in our lobby lounge, then visit our neighbourhood-inspired eatery for farm-to-plate delights. Have a drink at our cocktail bar

facts.text: Complimentary parking is available for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary parking is available at Kimpton Maa-Lai Bangkok for hotel guests.

facts.text: The hotel does not offer a complimentary local area shuttle.
facts.excerpt: No, there is not a complimentary local area shuttle available at Kimpton Maa-Lai Bangkok.

facts.text: Lumphini Park is 0.3 kilometers from the hotel.

facts.excerpt: Yes, the Kimpton Maa-Lai Bangkok offers free WiFi!
